content:
The **Ultracite Terror Sword** is a weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Gleaming Depths* update.

A two-handed sword made resembling the tooth of an Ultracite Terror. It deals both Physical and Poison Damage, in addition of poisoning enemies hit for ten seconds.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Acid (1) Adhesive (2) Bone (12) Cloth (2) Legendary Module (2) Screw (1) Steel (7) | | **Built or Scrapped:****Plan:** | | | 

Has a chance to be awarded for defeating the Ultracite Terror during Raid: Gleaming Depths.
